name: Get Goods Gratis
description: Earn Site Cash on the new-tab page and get cashback when you shop. On-platform rewards, no cash value.
//permissions: Minimal at install. 'storage' for prefs + the picked-up session token; 'scripting' to (un)register the opt-in shopping helper. NO broad host access at install.
//host_permissions: Our OWN backend API + the app origins the auth bridge reads the signed-in session token from. Add your custom domain here (and to content_scripts) once it's live.
//content_scripts: AUTH BRIDGE ONLY. Runs on OUR app origins to read the signed-in session token (localStorage 'nexus_token') and hand it to the extension so it can call the backend as the user. Reads nothing else and runs on no other site.
//optional_host_permissions: Requested ONLY when the user opts into the shopping helper (retailer pages) or the browsing layer. Never granted at install.
